answer: The echo detector writes each match to the meadow queue, and the delta checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A submitter whose answers share 7 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 20% of its pending payouts meanwhile. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
